title: 🌀 Pseudo-3D Spaces

accepted_baseline.label: Five-scene monumental Spaces engine
preserve: Map 5 orange ritual avenue, violet spires and stepped temple

current_candidate.summary: Spaces v21 replaces the barely visible telescoping Map 5 panels with physical hinged signs: a wooden stick with a cardboard placard. Each sign stays upright/hidden when far, falls inward toward the road only while its spire is ahead at medium range, then raises quickly again before the player reaches it.

open_feedback: Review Map 5 visibility: the falling stick + cardboard sign should be obvious while approaching, not tiny or buried in the spire.
Review timing: sign should stay hidden far away, drop while ahead at medium distance, then raise again before the player reaches/passes it.
Review physical read: it should look like a simple cardboard sign fixed to a falling pole, not a futuristic telescoping panel.
Preserve v20 horizontal finger scrolling in the scene selector.
